narrative.overview: A tidy, well-lit desk where the paper you need is already laid out: white and cool blue-grey ground, sea-ink navy text, a single Asesorfy blue for action, Fraunces headings with Inter interface. Two materials: interface (white cards, fields, tinted bands) and paper (the generated document sheet and clause cards, on a longer, lower shadow). A yellow highlighter is the only warmth and marks what matters.
keyCharacteristics: White and cool-tint ground, navy ink, one blue for action.
Fraunces for every heading, Inter for every control and body line.
Soft, cool, ink-tinted shadows; no hard edges.
Paper sheet for legal output; highlighter for emphasis.
At most one navy block per page above the footer.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Asesorfy Blue is the only chromatic action colour; no second accent for buttons or links.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Yellow only as mark over meaningful words; never a block, button or border.

rules.name: The One Dark Block Rule
rules.body: At most one navy surface per page above the footer, marking the key tool.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks, The Sans Works Rule
rules.body: Fraunces for what is said (headings, titles, legends, clauses); Inter for what is operated or read in bulk.

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings balance-wrap at line-height 1.12; paragraphs wrap pretty.

rules.name: The Stack-Don't-Shrink Rule
rules.body: Narrow screens stack columns; inputs stay at 16px or larger.

rules.name: The Paper Floats Rule
rules.body: Legal output sits on the deepest, longest shadow with the smallest radius.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Linked cards lift 2-3px with a #b8cce5 border; buttons lift 1px; nothing else moves on hover.

dos: Do take values from the :root tokens in assets/site.css and brand.css, not drifted inline values on older pages.
Do set headings, card titles and legends in Fraunces 600; controls in Inter.
Do show legal output on the paper sheet and highlight the words that matter.
Do close every tool page with the Blue Wash 'información orientativa' disclaimer.
Do use stroke line icons (16-22px) in rounded-square tint tiles.
donts: Don't add a second action colour or use semantic green/amber/red outside verdicts and checks.
Don't use more than one navy block per page above the footer.
Don't use hard offset shadows, pure-black shadows, or glows beyond the primary button's underglow.
Don't put small uppercase tracked eyebrows or kickers above headings.
Don't use initials or letter glyphs in place of icons.
Don't shrink form inputs below 16px on mobile.
